scope: Deterministic Tier1 A/B candidate with annual pooled storage, chronological checks and historical fixed-portfolio replays

findings: A 20MW mostly reallocates saleable electricity; only 8.1% of 2023 H2 input is contemporaneous surplus.
At a 3GBP2020/kg netback neither policy invests on the design year.
